responsibility: Defines the core interner-parameterized type-system data model for `rustc_type_ir`: the main enums and structs for types, regions, constants, aliases, trait objects, generators, and related IR forms, along with their ordering, hashing, encoding/decoding, stable hashing, and debug/display behavior. This is the crate’s central representation layer for the shape of Rust types and lifetimes independent of any particular compiler context.
